definitions.explanation: A meeting held at fixed intervals, such as weekly, monthly, or quarterly. Used in workplaces, government bodies, and community organizations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{月曜|げつよう}→月曜：30298_getsuyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{定例会|ていれいかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a regular meeting every Monday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定例会|ていれいかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: This month's regular meeting will be held online.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市議会|しぎかい}→市議会：23608_shigikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定例会|ていれいかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{条例|じょうれい}→条例：08255_jourei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{審議|しんぎ}→審議：19112_shingi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new ordinance was deliberated at the regular city council meeting.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both in corporate environments (⟦{定例|ていれい}→定例：11502_teirei⟧⟦ミーティング→ミーティング：05506_miitingu⟧ is also common) and in government bodies like ⟦{市議会|しぎかい}→市議会：23608_shigikai⟧{定例会|ていれいかい} (regular city council session).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定例会|ていれいかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to hold a regular meeting)
- ⟦{月例|げつれい}→月例：14940_getsurei⟧{定例会|ていれいかい} (monthly regular meeting)
- {定例会|ていれいかい}⟦{議事録|ぎじろく}→議事録：07482_gijiroku⟧ (regular meeting minutes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {臨時会|りんじかい}: extraordinary meeting — called for a special purpose outside the regular schedule
- ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: meeting — general term, not necessarily regular
